THE FOLLOWING RESULTS WERE OBTAINED BY MANUALLY RUNNING THE "./fp16_num X.0 Y.0" COMMAND IN THE TERMINAL. THEN, THEY WERE COPIED HERE MANUALLY.

./fp16_num 7.0 25.0

ff16_b = 25 (0-10000011-1001000)
ff16_c = 175 (0-10000110-0101111)

ff16_c = 0.25 (0-01111101-0000000)
